neighbours.label: ' and' in 'try and <verb>' (try-and in place of try-to)
fire: We should all try and find a better way to handle the problem.
Just don't try and start a fight with him at the party tonight.
The goal is to try and detect the illness before symptoms appear.
I'll try and call you back later this evening if I can.
She asked him to try and get some sleep before the long drive.
Let's try and finish the painting before the weekend is over.
They decided to try and raise money for the local shelter.
You could try and fix the leak yourself before calling a plumber.
quiet: We should all work together and find a better way to handle the problem.
Just don't try to start a fight with him at the party tonight.
The goal is to detect the illness early and treat it before symptoms appear.
I'll call you back later this evening and explain if I can.
She asked him to rest and get some sleep before the long drive.
Let's buy more paint and finish before the weekend is over.
They decided to bake cookies and raise money for the local shelter.
You could buy a wrench and fix the leak yourself before calling a plumber.

notes: top examples also include O'Connor surname piece; test covers the dominant ' and' trigger
